item.title: Re: Carnivorous Tattoo
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi there MisterNightmare013. Let’s take a look at your concept.

+crit
-crit

Unfortunately, I’m not sure I completely understand how your scp functions at the moment. So it’s a predatory tattoo that “appears” on random people’s skin? Why wouldn’t the victim automatically be suspicious of its appearance?

Claw mark-like tattoos over existing tattoos/bare skin that seem to sting as would normal claw marks would also appear.

What does this mean? Perhaps you should clarify your wording.

Eventually it would kill its victim in the way the predator its based off would normally kill its prey (bruises associated with being constricted being tattooed on the victim or gashes from claws as well)

Similarly for this statement. How exactly does a victim die? More importantly, why is this happening to victims? How/when does the tattoo appear or choose its victims? There are also sections of your central narrative that jump about and don’t make sense, mainly:

- why would the Foundation investigate a random string of murders? What made them anomalous to begin with?
- why is the Foundation agent sensing a stinging sensation?
- “the form of extinct species of Kaprosuchu” what’s the relevance of this?
- “the Agent willingly accepted being contained and observed to determine the entities behavior.” I’d think the Foundation would conduct more than just observations if they discovered the entity was a tattoo.
- “Its main way of hunting would appear to try and make its prey paranoid all the while it toys with its prey.” I still don’t understand how this would work. Perhaps you could give a specific, detail example.

The concept itself sounds cool, but I have a feeling you have not fleshed out the exact mechanics of your proposed scip. As a result, its anomalous properties sound random / too fantastical and as a result, I can’t really imagine the scp as realistically working.

If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I’ll take another look. Best of luck!

item.title: Re: Carnivorous Tattoo
item.content:encoded:
Thank you for the critics. To answer your questions (which i plan to add to the rewrite) I’ll answer them in order:

  • Yes this scp will be able to infect others if certain conditions are met
  • I chose to include extinct predatory animals for the purpose similar to how some predators use lures to draw in prey. With how popular tattoos are, more fancy exotic tattoos would catch the eyes of would be prey which the scp wants.
  • being a predatory creature the reason it stayed on the agent allowing it to be contained is because by the time the foundation got a hold of the corpse of the latest victim it was basically starving so the moment it jumped to the agent it was going to hunt the agent despite it being obvious that it would be captured.
  • I did plan to have a interview segment with the agent and a foundation scientist

item.title: Carnivorous Tattoo
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP-#### “The Predatory Tattoo” is entity in the form of a tattoo usually appearing to look like a predatory creature ranging from several present day predators to extinct/unknown species. It primarily targets individuals with atleast 3 or more tattoos but will on rare occasions appear on individuals with little to no tattoos. At first it’ll just be seen as a tattoo that the victim wouldn’t seem to have any memory of getting it. As time goes on the victim will notice slight imperfections with the tattoo, such as it seeming to be out of place and its eyes seeming to be looking up. Claw mark-like tattoos over existing tattoos/bare skin that seem to sting as would normal claw marks would also appear. Eventually it would kill its victim in the way the predator its based off would normally kill its prey (bruises associated with being constricted being tattooed on the victim or gashes from claws as well)

Central Narrative: the anomalous entity would first be discovered after the latest victim in a string of murder was brought to the attention of the foundation. Agents disguised as Federal agents would confiscate the recent body as well as all files on previous victims. After transferring the corpse to a foundation facility, one of the retrieval agents would discover an tattoo of unknown origin on his back after feeling a stinging sensation and seeing the scp taking the form of extinct species of Kaprosuchus. Upon discovering the entity, the Agent willingly accepted being contained and observed to determine the entities behavior. After the agents death from the scp, the skin of the agents back was removed, preserved and placed in a frame with the scp still in place with physical contact being heavily restricted to prevent containment breaches.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: it has two primary ways of transferring to a new prey host, either by direct touching of the current area it is inhabiting or by viewing the scp for a certain amount of time however these depend on several factors the primary being if it had recently fed and the ability to transfer can be prevented via two way mirrors in its containment cell. The ‘ink’ comprising of both the scp and the wounds it inflicts would contain partial dna mixed in with the normal content of the tattoo ink. Its main way of hunting would appear to try and make its prey paranoid all the while it toys with its prey.

Additional Notes: As stated, normal means one would take to remove a tattoo does not seem to work with the person attempting to remove the entity reporting feeling unnerved and/or receive tattooed markings in the form of self defensive slashes or bites. The reasoning behind its use of extinct/unidentifiable species is the means of a lure, by being more exotic the entity would attract more attention by tattoo enthusiasts ensuring possible new prey hosts.
